subject: general
question: As of 2022, 12-feet statue of Adi Shankaracharya, which was unveiled by the Prime Minister of India is located in _________
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kedarnath**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A 12-feet statue of Adi Shankaracharya was unveiled by the Prime Minister of India in **Kedarnath** in 2022.
 
• Adi Shankaracharya was an 8th-century Indian philosopher and theologian who consolidated the doctrine of Advaita Vedanta.
 
• The statue is located at the Kedarnath Temple, one of the holiest Hindu shrines dedicated to Lord Shiva.
 
• This statue is part of a redevelopment project aimed at restoring and improving the Kedarnath temple complex.
 
• The unveiling of the statue is seen as a significant step in preserving and promoting India's spiritual heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kedarnath** is located in the Indian state of Uttarakhand and is part of the Char Dham pilgrimage circuit.
 
• The temple is situated at an altitude of 3,583 meters (11,755 feet) above sea level, near the Chorabari Glacier, the source of the Mandakini river.
 
• Kedarnath Temple was originally built by the Pandavas and is one of the twelve Jyotirlingas, the holiest Hindu shrines of Lord Shiva.
 
• The region around Kedarnath is prone to natural disasters; in 2013, it was severely affected by flash floods, leading to extensive damage and loss of lives.
 
• Since then, significant efforts have been made to rebuild and restore the temple and its surroundings, ensuring safety and accessibility for pilgrims.
